Name: Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS][i][color=#fff2cc]Changes Hilltop Farm into a tidier, more natural-looking map. Comes with dynamic summit view, a hot spring, custom quarry and various qql tweaks![/color][/i][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=2][u][b][font=Trebuchet MS]Big thanks to @clownedcat (Twitter) for commissioning me for this map and also kindly allowed me to upload this farm mod here on nexus![/font][/b][/u][/size][/center]

[center][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]This map inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko's[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15618]Zenith Farm[/url]﻿﻿, check it out if you want more spacious hilltop farm![/font][/size]

[line]
[/center]
[center][b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][u][color=#f9cb9c][i]Note:[/i] [/color][/u]This mod comes in two versions: one adds Hilltop Farm as a separate custom farm and does not affect the vanilla Hilltop Farm, while the other replaces the vanilla Hilltop Farm.[/font][/size][/b]
[b][b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]If you're starting a new save, I recommend using the first version to avoid potential conflicts with other farm mods.[/font][/size][/b][/b][/center]

[img]https://imgur.com/5nfFjjv.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Animated summit view with dynamic weather effects.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Custom starter gift box — choose your starting items before beginning a new save![/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Custom quarry map with a working minecart.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Entrance located in top left corner of the map. You can plant crops and build farm buildings there.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Hot spring — swim in the lake and restore your energy.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Better fishing — catch Mountain and Forest fish in farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Respawnable Hardwood Stumps — one stump respawns each day in the bottom-left area of the map, with up to three stumps available.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Forest forage spawns in farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Every tile is diggable.[/font]
[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Extra pathways to:[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]        - Secret Woods — located in the bottom-left corner of the map. The path is blocked by a Hardwood Log.
        - Cindersap Forest — warps you to a tile behind the large pink tree.
        - SVE Grandpa's Shed — located in the bottom-right corner of the map.[/font][/size]
[center][/center]
[line]

[url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Don't want fences, access to quarry map or hot spring?[/b] You can disable the features in mod's config![/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f9cb9c][u]Note:[/u][/color][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod [/url] is recommended for more convenient ingame configuration.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#93c47d]Visual Effects:[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Dynamic Panorama - Adds animated panorama view, which changes with weather and time (MMAP mod is required).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=2]Mist Effect - Adds mist effect overlay in farm on rainy days.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#93c47d]Farm Features:[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Starter Gift - Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (only works on new save file - choose before creating new save file.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Starter Giftbox items available: [/font][/size][/*]
[/list][spoiler][size=2]*NOTE: Small Magned ring is added in every giftbox.[/size]

[quote][size=2]﻿﻿- Farming - 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿- Foraging -  10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing -  1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating - 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
 ﻿-Mining - 1 furnace and "Miner's Treat" food item
﻿- Ranching - 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿- Floristing - 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿- Jojaing - ???  [/size][/quote][/spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Fences - Adds fences on cliff edges.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Hot Spring - Adds hot spring in bottom left corner of farm map in which you can swim and restore energy.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Wooden Dock - Adds small wooden dock with a lamp.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Farmhouse Rope Bridge - Adds rope bridge between farmhouse and greenhouse.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]SVE Grandpha's Shed Warp - Adds pathway to Grandpha's Shed map in bottom right corner of farm map if SVE is installed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Spouse Patio Tiles - Adds spouse patio stone tiles on the ground.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#93c47d][size=3][b]Quarry Features:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Quarry Rope Bridge - Adds pathway to custom quarry map in left side of the farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Minecart in Quarry - Adds minecart to Quarry which is connected to vanilla minecart system.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#f6b26b]Don't want respawnable stumps/forage/quarry ore nodes? [/color][/b][/font][/size]
[b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]You can manually disable it:[/font][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Go to your "Mods" folder, open "Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm", > "[FTM] Small Hilltop Farm" [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Open content.json file with any text editor. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Find the strings:[/font][/size]
"LargeObjectSpawnEnabled""OreSpawnEnabled""ForageSpawnEnabled"[/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]change desired ones to "false"[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Save the changes.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Reload your save file.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[img]https://imgur.com/FfJ4Gp9.png[/img]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#d9ead3][b]Compatible[/b][/color] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, ect...
[b][color=#d9ead3]Compatible[/color] [/b]with any recolors and retextures. 
[color=#ea9999][b]Not compatible[/b][/color] with any other mod that edits the Hilltop Farm (If Vanilla HIlltop Farm mod version is used)

[u][color=#ffe599][b]NOTE for SVE compatibility[/b][/color][/u] [b]- the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is [color=#ffe599]x = 36, y = 22 [/color]- change it in SVE config.[/b][/font][/size]
[line]

[img]https://imgur.com/K3YgnyS.png[/img]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Since it's really tidy map, I highly recommend using [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6854][b]Build on Any Tile [/b][/url]or [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url].[/b] [/font][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]Crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Unzip "Aimon's Small Hilltop Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS]Enjoy.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
